changelog:
Initial release: Enforces an end-to-end, standardized workflow for writing and publishing WeChat Official Account articles, including H/K/R checks, self-check templates, strict cover image rules, and server-aware publishing.

- All writing, even for "test" or "try it" requests, follows strict multi-step process: topic judgment, archetype selection, L1-L4 self-check, and house style enforcement.
- Cover image workflow uses gpt-image-2 via LuisClaw relay, requires user confirmation of prompt, and applies project custom requirements.
- Article typesetting performed using gzh-design, passing automated validation and preview checks.
- Publishing handled with preflight verification, draft existence safety, and post-publish confirmation.
- Safety rules forbid including sensitive secrets or credentials in deliverables.
- Includes templates, references, and concrete example files for each workflow step.
summary: End-to-end WeChat Official Account article studio for Chinese公众号内容. Use when asked to write, test, package, typeset, generate covers for, publish, or verify...
